[[File:Imperial_Diplomat.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Diplomatic Corps]]
{{Quote|The Empire's diplomacy branch is an oft-overlooked but necessary function when dealing with hostile worlds. The ambassadors and negotiators attached to the Diplomatic Corps ensure that occupied populations adhere to the Emperor's dictates, reducing the need for pacification by force.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Diplomatic Corps''', also known as the '''Diplomatic Service''' or '''Diplo-Serv''', was a much-honored albeit overlooked branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] that functioned as a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] body, bringing new [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and enforcing Imperial standards during [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. They often deployed ambassadors and negotiators to hostile worlds to ensure that the occupied populations adhere to the Emperor's orders, and as such reducing the necessity for pacification by force. However, the ambassadors and negotiators were notoriously corrupt, which also ended up costing the Empire by having them accept bribes by Rebel agents.

==History==
{{Quote|Notoriously corrupt, every one of them. Their willingness to take bribes has been a huge asset for the rebels.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], commenting on Imperial Diplomatic Corps members in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide" />}}
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Jahan Cross]]' cover story was that he was assigned to the Diplomatic Service.<ref name="Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref>

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zeta Traal]] was a member of the Imperial Diplomatic Corps and was assigned to act as an official attaché to the royal regent [[Zelor]] on the planet [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Velmor">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030306velmor|text=Velmor: Royalty and Rebellion|int=Velmor: Royalty and Rebellion}}</ref>

Following the death of Palpatine at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Imperial Diplomatic Corps found it had acquired a new role&mdash;keeping worlds already in the Empire from leaving. This task strained the resources of the Corps, and junior diplomats who would have been closely supervised in the past were given greater autonomy as a result.<ref name="H&R">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>

In the [[Fel Empire|Fel]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empires]], the Diplomatic Corps was under the control of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Fehlaaur'aitel'loro]], a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]. The organization knew [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] but knew nothing of [[Cade Skywalker|his son]].<ref name="Legacy 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref>
